name: Library
shortDescription: A quiet world of books, stories and research.
detailedDescription: The library is a calm space for reading, research and discovery. Shelves hold storybooks, reference books, magazines and newspapers. Reading programs, book clubs and library periods help students build a lifelong reading habit.
